auto lo
iface lo inet loopback

iface ens3 inet6 manual

auto vmbr0
iface vmbr0 inet6 static
	address 2001:db8:cb:0:5054:ff:fe12:3456/64
	gateway fe80::2
	bridge-ports ens3
	bridge-stp off
	bridge-fd 0

source /etc/network/interfaces.d/*
